entities.name: Wolfram von Eschenbach
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Wolfram von Eschenbach was a German knight, poet and composer, regarded as one of the greatest epic poets of medieval German literature. As a Minnesinger, he also wrote lyric poetry.
